snippet.title: Tales Of Klodan Cinematic Trailer
snippet.description:
Tales of Klodan is a visual novel in the medieval fantasy genre with elements of boys’ love, LGBTQ+, romance, and dating simulation.

We are on Steam: https://bit.ly/talesofklodan

The story follows a young ambassador from Fescillia who arrives in the dark, snow-covered land of Klodan to establish trade relations after a long and grueling war. However, things turn out to be far more complicated than they first seemed.

Choose your path and uncover one of five unique endings!

Follow us on:

X: https://x.com/VoodooSisters
